The app shows the release date on the deposit.

## Returned checks

If the check bounces after the money was made available, we take the amount back from your balance. There's no returned item fee.

Deposits made on a weekend or bank holiday count as received on the next business day.

## Check the status

Tap the deposit in your activity feed to see whether it's pending, available or returned.

Still stuck? Chat with us in the app. Someone is there around the clock.

[check-deposit-availability] When check deposits are available (effective 2025-01-01)
Once your check deposit is accepted, here's when you can use the money.

## Standard availability

- The first $225 is available the next business day.
- The rest is available within 2 business days.

## New accounts

For accounts open less than 30 days, we may hold check deposits for up to 7 business days.

## Longer holds

We may also hold a check longer if it's unusually large for your account, if the check looks altered, or if it has been returned before. The app shows the release date on the deposit.

## New device

For 24 hours after you sign in on a new device, transfers above $500 can't be sent.

## Incoming transfers

If money sent to you hasn't arrived, check with the sender's bank when it was sent. Direct deposits usually arrive as soon as your employer's payment file reaches us.

[account-verification-time] How long verification takes (effective 2025-01-01)
Most applications are verified within 1 business day, and many within minutes.

## Manual review

If we need to check something by hand, it can take up to 5 business days. We may ask for another document, such as proof of address.

## While you wait

You can receive deposits into your new account, but you can't send money, withdraw cash or order a card until you're verified.

## Checking status

The app shows your verification status on the home screen. We'll notify you as soon as it's done.

## Keep the check

Keep the paper check for 14 days after it's deposited, then destroy it. Don't deposit the same check anywhere else.

## Checks we can't accept

Checks made out to someone else, checks from outside the US, money orders, and checks without the endorsement above.

## When the money is available

See "When check deposits are available". The app shows the release date after you submit the deposit.

Questions? Our support team is available in the app at any hour.

[transfers-pending] Why is my transfer pending? (effective 2025-01-01)
A transfer can show as pending for a few reasons. Here's how to tell what's going on.

## Waiting for the cutoff

ACH transfers submitted after 4:00 PM ET, or on a weekend or holiday, stay pending until they're sent on the next business day.

## On its way

Once sent, ACH transfers take 1 to 3 business days to arrive. The app shows the expected arrival date on the transfer.

## Under review

Some transfers are reviewed before they're sent, for example a large first transfer to a newly linked account. The app shows

[disputes-pending] Why can't I dispute a pending transaction? (effective 2025-01-01)
any more charges. When the transaction posts, dispute it as unauthorized. Your dispute window starts from the statement it posts on, so you won't lose time by waiting.

## If the amount is wrong

Pending amounts are often estimates, for example at gas pumps or hotels. The posted amount is usually different. Wait and see what posts.

## If it's been pending a long time

Some merchants take longer. If a transaction has been pending much longer than usual, message support and we'll look at it.
